SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI says its frontier models and Codex agentic workflows are coming to Google Cloud's Model Garden so enterprises can use them where they already build.

SIGNALS.name: Claude
SIGNALS.summary: Anthropic opened a research preview of Claude Duet, an app where Claude acts as a proactive agent that surfaces what needs attention and checks before acting.

SIGNALS.name: Artificial Analysis
SIGNALS.summary: Artificial Analysis says HeyGen Voice Turbo now ranks first on its Controlled Voice text-to-speech arena leaderboard, ahead of the earlier HeyGen Voice at second.

SIGNALS.name: Recursive
SIGNALS.summary: Recursive released Flint, its first model, built with its automated research system. It targets fast local coding, and open weights are on Hugging Face.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI packaged a Codex skill that guides site owners through checking whether their website is affected by the recently disclosed web security issue.

SIGNALS.name: DIP Goa
SIGNALS.summary: Goa's information department says the two-day Goa AI Tech Conclave 2026 opens in Panaji, bringing together academia, tech leaders and entrepreneurs.

SIGNALS.name: Arthur Mensch
SIGNALS.summary: Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch says AI for industrial engineering is a key research pillar and that Mistral is deepening its partnership with NVIDIA for manufacturing.

SIGNALS.name: News from Google
SIGNALS.summary: Google Public Sector is launching Gemini for government services, aimed at helping federal, state and local agencies streamline complex operations.

SIGNALS.name: ChatGPT
SIGNALS.summary: ChatGPT adds Locked Chats, a protected space outside regular history and search, unlocked by PIN on web and desktop or by biometrics on supported mobile devices.
